## Project Overview
Full-stack web application for comprehensive Israeli football stadiums database with advanced search functionality.

## Key Features
- Stadium search by name, city, or partial matches
- Detailed stadium information pages
- Responsive design for all devices
- Database management for stadium data
- RESTful API for stadium information

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
- Backend: Node.js with Express.js
- Database: SQLite for development, PostgreSQL for production
- Search: Full-text search with fuzzy matching
- Styling: CSS Grid/Flexbox with mobile-first approach

## Development Guidelines
- Use semantic HTML structure
- Implement progressive enhancement
- Follow REST API conventions
- Include comprehensive error handling
- Write clean, documented code
- Ensure accessibility compliance

## Stadium Data Structure
Each stadium entry should include:
- Name (Hebrew and English)
- City location
- Capacity
- Home team(s)
- Year built/renovated
- Surface type
- Coordinates
- Image gallery
- Historical information

## Search Functionality
- Real-time search suggestions
- Partial name matching
- City-based filtering
- Advanced filters (capacity, league level)
- Search result highlighting
